correctness.rationale: For the integral cyclic Klein cubic reduced over the algebraic closure of F_11, direct substitution verifies P=(1:3:9:5:4) and vanishing first derivatives. The transverse x2,x3,x4 Hessian minor is 8 mod 11 and full Hessian rank is three. The exact critical section (3v^5,9v^6,5v^4,4v^8) satisfies all transverse equations; restriction gives h(v)=3v^5+8v^16=-3v^5(v-1)^11 modulo 11, with v-1 a valid local parameter. Characteristic 11 is odd; formal implicit and parametric Morse splitting then reduce by contact equivalence to sum of three squares+t^11. The t^12 comparator has the same Tjurina length but different residual order; computed local data, not a finite census, prove exponent eleven. Independent finite-field polynomial/Hessian substitution agreed. A published claim of type A2 for the same point is in direct apparent conflict; its label alone does not refute the demonstrated formal identity, but the discrepancy must be investigated rather than hidden.
